subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference for Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-cloud.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: chris.morgan@acme-cloud.com
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference for Acme Cloud

Hi Ben,

I signed up via your self-serve flow and would love to schedule a demo next week to see how Redwood could help reduce token costs and improve latency for our multi-tenant inference workloads. We’re running across the US and EMEA (we’re based in London) so any notes about cross-region routing and VPC deployment would be great.

For scheduling: I’m flexible but prefer mornings UK time (09:00–11:30 BST) or afternoons US PST (14:00–17:00 PST). Our IT/security lead Leah Gomez and our infra lead Chris Morgan will join — Leah will want a short security-focused segment (SOC 2, data residency, KMS/HSM).

Can you propose a few slots? Also, happy to share an engineering contact if you want a pre-call.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
Acme Cloud

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, chris.morgan@acme-cloud.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference for Acme Cloud

Hey Sam — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for signing up.

Would love to run a 45–60 minute session with:
- 20–25m product + AE tour (use cases, model catalog, routing/fallbacks)
- 15–20m SE deep-dive (performance, batching, quantization)
- 10–15m security + Q&A (SOC2, KMS, logging)

Suggested slots (all shown with BST / PDT conversions):
- Wed 21 Jul — 10:00 BST / 02:00 PDT (tight for Leah?)
- Wed 21 Jul — 15:00 BST / 07:00 PDT
- Thu 22 Jul — 09:30 BST / 01:30 PDT

Marissa (SE) will join to run the technical portion — looping her here. Also including a one-page agenda (attached). If Leah prefers, we can split security into a separate 30-min follow-up — whatever works for your calendar.

If any of those work, I’ll send a calendar invite with an explicit timezone conversion and include a short pre-demo checklist.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Leah

Acme Cloud

Ben / Neha — quick internal note before I join the call. Leah asked specifically for SOC2, logging, and KMS details. I can run the SE deep-dive and reserve 15–20 minutes for security. Neha, can you prepare the short rundown on our KMS integrations + audit log retention (3–5 bullets) so we can hit it in the demo? Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Logistics:
- Meeting: Wed 21 Jul, 15:00–16:00 BST (07:00–08:00 PDT)
- Format: 45 minutes demo + 15 minutes security deep-dive / open Q&A
- Join link: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/rdw-acme-21july

See you all soon — Ben
